title.narrative: Investing in Business Enabling Environment (iBEE)

description.narrative: The proposed Action will support: i) an improved business environment through enhanced capacity of the private sector for dialogue on the business climate with the government; ii) better export capacity and increased market attractiveness of Tanzania through the strengthening of services provided by the business associations operating in Tanzania.

description.narrative: 3. Improved dialogue framework

title.narrative: Improving business environment signaled by business registration

description.narrative: Improving business environment will be used to gauge effectiveness of dialogue. In this indicator, business registration will be used as a proxy for improving business environment. The number of new businesses registered should be higher than deregistered and at an increasing rate between 2022 and 2023. BRELA data will be used for this indicator coupled with World Development Indicators (Private sector in the economy) by the World Bank

comment.narrative: This indicator will track number of new businesses registered compared to the World Bank baseline of 2018.
